title: Independently review combined auth UI and security candidate
objective: Independently review the serially integrated exact candidate against the latest contract and original review document. Return APPROVE, REJECT or REQUEST_CHANGES with reproducible blockers. This is separate from BOSS milestone acceptance.
allowed_scope: approved combined source and redacted evidence read-only
acceptance_criteria: Independent reviewer did not implement the candidate
Review actual generic signup/recovery proof/MFA/admission/session races, canonical provider/FK/RLS/hook and media/CSP boundaries
Exact public-config candidate, executable dependency reports and signed evidence rejection cases reviewed
Precise verdict and blocking evidence delivered to Supervisor for canonical state handoff
required_tests: Read and independently reproduce material negative regressions on owned fixtures
Verify handoff source/artifact/run/role identities and required full gates
Check original plan sign-offs against evidence; no inferred acceptance
